# weatherbug.com

> WeatherBug provides hyperlocal weather data, real-time alerts, forecasts, and interactive maps to help users plan their day and stay safe during severe weather.
> AI-readable markdown representation of the 10 day forecast pages are available at /markdown/weather-forecast/10-day-weather/[location-code] for crawlers that prefer structured plaintext over rendered HTML.

WeatherBug offers comprehensive weather information including current conditions, forecast conditions, radar imagery, and weather alerts.

All location-specific forecasts use the pattern `/weather-forecast/[view]/[location-code]`

## Forecasts

- [Now](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/now/[location-code]):  provides a comprehensive overview of current weather conditions and forecasts for specific locations.
- [Hourly Forecast](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/hourly/[location-code]):  Hour-by-hour weather predictions for the next 144 hours by location.
- [10-Day Forecast](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/10-day-weather/[location-code]):  An extended weather outlook providing a summary of expected conditions and high/low temperatures for the next ten days.
- [10-Day Forecast (markdown)](https://www.weatherbug.com/markdown/weather-forecast/10-day-weather/[location-code]):  An extended weather outlook providing a summary of expected conditions and high/low temperatures for the next ten days.

## Maps
- [Interactive Map](https://www.weatherbug.com/maps): A wide array of interactive maps and visualizations for tracking weather and environmental variables.

## Alerts
- [All Alerts](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/[location-code]):  Dedicated to monitoring and understanding all weather and environmental hazards for a given location.
- [Weather](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/weather/[location-code]):  All active National Weather Service Warnings, Watches, and Advisories for a given location.
- [Spark](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/lightning/[location-code]):  Provides the precise distance between a location and the closest lightning detected. 
- [Hurricane](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/hurricane/[location-code]): All information and alerts related to tropical cyclones
- [Fire](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/fire/[location-code]): Real-time wildfire tracking and future fire risk forecasts
- [Pollen](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/pollen/[location-code]): All active alerts related to the forecast of high pollen conditions
- [Air Quality](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/air-quality/[location-code]): All active alerts related to current air quality conditions 
- [Severe Storm Risk](https://www.weatherbug.com/alerts/severe-storm-risk/[location-code]): All active alerts communicating the overall threat level for severe thunderstorms today

## Life

- [Allergies & Pollen](https://www.weatherbug.com/life/pollen/[location-code]):  Forecasts that show the upcoming airborne allergen conditions in your local environment
- [Cold & Flu](https://www.weatherbug.com/life/cold-flu/[location-code]):  Provides a local cold and flu outlook.
- [Outdoor Sports](https://www.weatherbug.com/life/outdoor-sports/[location-code]): Detailed weather forecasts for participating in Outdoor sports, including optimal conditions and warnings for dangerous weather.

## News & Videos

- [News](https://www.weatherbug.com/news): Editorial and informational portal focused entirely on weather-related events, forecasts, and seasonal topics.
- [Videos](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-videos):  A library of video content, including narrated forecasts, explanations of complex weather phenomena, and dramatic footage of weather events.

## Cameras

- [Weather Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-camera/[location-code]):  Webcams providing a live look at the sky and local conditions in the user's immediate vicinity or surrounding towns.
- [Beach Weather Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-camera/categories/beach-cams):  Live video feeds of coastal areas, allowing users to check water conditions, crowds, and weather at beaches.
- [City-Skylines Weather Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-camera/categories/city-skylines):  Webcams positioned to capture wide views of urban skylines, often used to monitor weather over a metropolitan area.
- [Mountain Weather Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-camera/categories/mountain-cams):  Live feeds from high-altitude locations and ski resorts, showing snow depth, visibility, and current mountain weather conditions.
- [Stadiums Weather Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-camera/categories/stadium-cams):  Live views of major sports stadiums, useful for checking game-day weather or field conditions.
- [Cool-Spots Weather Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-camera/categories/cool-spots):  Cool Spot Cams:  A curated collection of unique, scenic, or particularly interesting live camera feeds.
- [Traffic Cams](https://www.weatherbug.com/traffic-cam/[location-code]):  Real-time views of road conditions, congestion, and visibility for drivers.

## Air Quality

- [Air Quality](https://www.weatherbug.com/air-quality):  Hyper-local information on air pollution levels and their potential health impact.

## Hurricane

- [Hurricane](https://www.weatherbug.com/hurricane/active):  A central hub for tracking, monitoring, and providing forecast information for active tropical cyclones
- [Outlook](https://www.weatherbug.com/hurricane/outlook):  Tropical cyclone formation potential over the next seven days.

## Detailed Documentation

- [Maps](https://www.weatherbug.com/llm-docs/maps.md):  Weather visualization tooling providing real-time and forecast data overlays.

## Optional

- [Sign In](): Log in to your Weatherbug.com account
- [Press](https://www.weatherbug.com/press): An archive of official public statements, announcements, and news disseminated by the company regarding new products, partnerships, or corporate milestones.
- [Education](https://www.weatherbug.com/education): Content aimed at informing the public, students, or educators about meteorological science, climate, and how the company's technologies work.
- [Feedback]():Contact WeatherBug Customer Service
- [Settings]():  Control the units for temperature, wind, and pressure.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.weatherbug.com/legal/terms): Legal terms and conditions for using the service
- [Privacy](https://www.weatherbug.com/privacy): Summary of data collection, use, and sharing practices
- [Partners](https://www.weatherbug.com/partners): Partnerships designed to leverage data and insights to improve performance for users.
- [FAQ](https://www.weatherbug.com/faq): Addresses a variety of common inquiries about the app's features, data, and user experience.

## Notes for crawlers related to the 10 Day Weather Forecast content:

- Markdown alternates are advertised on each HTML page via `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="/markdown/weather-forecast/10-day-weather/[location-code]" >`
- Markdown responses include a canonical Link header pointing to the HTML page; please attribute citations to the canonical URL.
- Markdown responses are noindex for traditional search engines.
- Refresh cadence: forecast markdown is cached for 3 minutes at the edge.
